主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. has completed a preferred share issue of CDN$200 million. This filing is part of the company's regulatory reporting under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing was published on March 13, 2014, and is a Form 6-K report. The company is a foreign private issuer and files its annual reports under Form 40-F. The filing includes an exhibit detailing the completion of the preferred share issue. The company's principal executive offices are located in Toronto, Canada.
